metadataReview.note: Reviewed extent: 20–21 November 1759. RCT RCIN 731066.bb dates the Daun–Finck combat to 20 November (its historical notation 9bre means November); the Genoa University Press scholarly edition explicitly gives Maxen on 20–21 November, p. 92. Replace the single imported 21 November start with the fuller extent. This does not claim continuous fighting for two days or verify any troop, loss or prisoner total. CDB90 covers only the 20 November combat interval and remains held from whole-battle import.
